question.text: A research entity must maintain an arms-length relationship between:

answer.text: Research activities and all other activities including IB, merchant banking, and brokerage

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 16(5)/24 requires a research entity to maintain an arms-length relationship between its research activities and all other activities. The Trap: The requirement is broad — it covers research vs all other activities of the entity, not just selected functions. Note: The arms-length requirement should be supported by written policies and documented separation of research from other activities.
